items.headline: Re’Shaun Sanford II breaks tie with long TD run as No. 17 Houston beats Cincinnati 31-24
items.description: — Re’Shaun Sanford II ran for 126 yards and the tiebreaking score in the fourth quarter, and Conner Weigman threw for 227 yards and two touchdowns as No. 17 Houston beat Cincinnati 31-24 on Saturday.
